From pipeline integrity to GIS intelligence and advanced analytics, our platform connects critical workflows into one scalable ecosystem. By embedding AI and machine learning into our technology, we help energy companies reduce risk, improve efficiency, and unlock real-time operational insight. We work with energy companies across Canada and internationally and we're redefining what modern energy software looks like. The Opportunity We're looking for curious, motivated Student Software Developers (3rd or 4th year) to join us for Spring 2026. This isn't a "sit in the corner and watch" internship. You'll contribute to real features used by real customers while learning from experienced developers who care about mentoring the next generation of tech talent. If you're excited about full stack development, AI-enabled products, and solving meaningful industry problems, keep reading. What you'll be doing • Collaborate with experienced developers and product experts to build software solutions for the energy industry • Write code across the full stack from front-end interfaces to database design • Create and and maintain AbaData features and functionality • Participate in code reviews, stand-ups, and get hands-on mentorship from senior developers • Test, troubleshoot, and debug software to a high bar of performance and reliability What's in it for you • A full-time paid hourly student internship for either a 4-month or 8-month term • Join a dynamic team at the forefront of innovation in software in the energy industry • Mentorship and learning opportunities with a supportive, experienced development team that's solving real-world problems • Work on AI-enabled products solving complex, real-world problems • A fun and collaborative culture including Slurpee Thursdays, Summer BBQ, and other team events Opportunities for growth and future roles with an established and growing company • Job Requirements Who we are looking for • 3rd or 4th year Computer Science or Engineering student • Familiarity with with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JS frameworks (e.g. React, Dojo) • Exposure to back-end development (e.g., C#/.NET, Node.js) • Experience with MS SQL Server or relationship databases is an asset • Excellent communication and teamwork skills Curiosity, eagerness to learn, and attention to detail • Bonus points if you have • Personal or school projects you're proud of (GitHub links welcome) Interest in geospatial data, mobile-first applications, or applied analytics • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Cover Letter Required?
